extName.message: Tabatha: Visual Tab Switcher with Live Previews

extDesc.message: Alt+Tab for Chrome tabs: live previews, instant search and recently closed tabs. Free, private, nothing leaves your computer.

cmdOpen.message: Open Tabatha / move to next tab

cmdReverse.message: Open Tabatha / move to previous tab

searchPlaceholder.message: Search open tabs and tabs closed in the last 7 days

sortSiteTitle.message: Group tabs from the same site together

groupsOnTitle.message: Show your Chrome tab groups here as sections, and keep them when you close them

noMatch.message: No open tabs match your search.

noStarredOpen.message: No open tabs are starred. Star one with the ☆ on its card.

sleepingTip.message: Sleeping: Chrome unloaded this tab to save memory. It reloads when you open it.

captureTitle.message: Shows this tab for a moment to take its picture, then comes back

pickTitle.message: Select (or Ctrl+click the card). Shift+click selects a range.

dupesTitle.message: Show the pages that are open more than once (same address, ignoring the #part). You then choose to close the extra copies.

sweepTitleAll.message: Shows each of your tabs for a moment to take its picture, then puts you back where you were.

sweepTitleThese.message: Shows each of these tabs for a moment to take its picture, then puts you back where you were.

sweepTitleOne.message: You can also capture one tab from its card.

actSleepTitle.message: Unload them to free memory once you leave Tabatha. They reload when you open them.

actFailed.message: That didn’t work. Chrome said no.

copyFailed.message: This page won’t let Tabatha use the clipboard. Try from the popup (New Tab page).

groupPinned.message: Pinned tabs can’t go into a group.

sleptNone.message: Nothing to put to sleep (Chrome won’t unload the tab you’re on).

groupsPaneOff.message: Turn on tab groups and the groups you close are kept here, like layers, until you remove them.

groupsPaneEmpty.message: No tab groups yet. Tick some tabs and choose Group, or make one in Chrome. Closed groups stay here until you delete them.

groupsPaneNoMatch.message: No saved group matches your search.

marksPaneOff.message: See and tidy your Chrome bookmarks here: open them, drag tabs into folders, rename and move them.

marksPaneOffNote.message: Chrome will ask to let Tabatha read and change your bookmarks. They stay in Chrome; Tabatha keeps no copy and sends nothing.

marksLoadFailed.message: Couldn’t read your bookmarks just now.

helpTitle.message: The Tabatha manual, on the website

coffeeTitle.message: Tabatha is free. If it saves you time, you can buy me a coffee.

proTitle.message: Tabatha stays free. Pro would add extras for heavy tab users: join the list to hear first.

tour1Body.message: Every open tab, with a preview.

tour3Body.message: Just type, anywhere in Tabatha. It finds open tabs and ones you closed in the last 7 days.

tourManyBody.message: Tick tabs with the box (or Ctrl+click). Then close, copy, group or bookmark them together from the bar at the bottom.

tour4Body.message: Your groups become sections. Closed ones stay saved until you remove them.

tour5Body.message: Tell me what’s broken or missing. I’ll fix it.

askTitle.message: How is Tabatha working for you?

askBody.message: Ten seconds. It tells me what to build next. Your answer stays on your computer; the buttons only open a page where you choose what to send.

askGoodBody.message: A review is the best way to help other people find Tabatha.

askBadBody.message: Tell me what would make it work for you. A review is welcome too, whenever you like.

reviewBtn.message: Review on the Chrome Web Store

askNote.message: Each opens in a new tab. Tabatha itself sends nothing.

hostBlocked.message: Chrome is keeping Tabatha away from your sites, so there are no previews yet.

hostBlockedTip.message: Chrome’s “Site access” for Tabatha isn’t set to “On all sites”. Without it Tabatha can’t take previews or hear Alt+Q on web pages.

hostThanks.message: Thanks. Tabatha can see your sites now. Previews fill in as you visit tabs.

capErrHost.message: Chrome isn’t letting Tabatha look at this page, so it has no picture. Allowing Tabatha on all sites usually fixes that.

capErrPage.message: Chrome doesn’t allow pictures of this kind of page.

capErrOther.message: Tabatha couldn’t take a picture of this page just now.

flyoutBody.message: Press $1 to see all your tabs.

flyoutSub.message: Or click the Tabatha icon in the toolbar.

nudgeBody.message: $1 shows all of them at once, with previews. Type to find one.

sweepNote.message: Each tab shows for a moment. You’ll be back where you were.

captureBlocked.message: Chrome doesn’t allow a preview of this page.

captureFailed.message: No preview this time: the page didn’t finish loading. Try again in a moment.

sleepLaterN_one.message: $1 tab will sleep when you leave Tabatha

sleepLaterN_other.message: $1 tabs will sleep when you leave Tabatha

sweepNothing.message: Nothing to capture: every tab here already has a preview, or can’t have one.

actCloseTitle.message: Close the selected tabs. They stay under Recently closed.

actCopyTitle.message: Copy their addresses, one per line

actCopyMdTitle.message: Copy “- [Title](link)” lines: they paste as clickable titles in Notion, Obsidian, GitHub, Slack or Docs

actBookmarkTitle.message: Save them as bookmarks (several go into a new folder)

actGroupTitle.message: Put them in a new Chrome tab group with a name and colour

actNewWindowTitle.message: Move them into a window of their own

dupesSummary_one.message: $1 extra copy: one tab of each page stays

dupesSummary_other.message: $1 extra copies: one tab of each page stays

groupNeedsPerm.message: Chrome will ask to let Tabatha name and colour groups (once).

gmDelete.message: Delete the group and its tabs

gmDeleteSure.message: Delete it and close $1 tabs? Click again

folderDeleteSure_one.message: Delete it and the bookmark inside? Click again

folderDeleteSure_other.message: Delete it and the $1 bookmarks inside? Click again

setStartupNote.message: Shows all your tabs, where you left off, a few seconds after Chrome opens.

shortcutMissing.message: Alt+Q isn’t set for Tabatha: another app or extension may have it. Pick a shortcut in Chrome.

iconTip.message: Tip: $1 opens Tabatha from anywhere, no mouse needed.

tourWinBody.message: Each Chrome window, with a picture of what it shows. Click one, or press Alt+W, to see only its tabs.

tourPanelBody.message: Your tab groups and Chrome bookmarks live in this panel. Closed groups stay saved until you delete them.

tourSetBody.message: Language, and opening Tabatha when Chrome starts.
